title: DanielGarbozo/hicpup-nf pipeline parameters
description: Downstream Hi-C fountain cone profiles: wraps the hicpup CLI (Module A).

input.help_text: `matrix` is a .cool or .hic file - a local path, a path relative to the pipeline directory, or an http(s)/ftp URL. Entries ending in .hic are converted by HIC2COOL first.

chromsizes.help_text: hicpup.views.build_views requires exactly 6 rows (5 autosomes + chrX, ce10 shape) and fails otherwise.

fountains_x.description: BED4 (chrom, start, end, strength) of chrX fountain anchors.
fountains_x.help_text: Enables view X. At least one of fountains_x / fountains_a must be set.

fountains_a.description: BED4 of autosomal fountain anchors. Optional.
fountains_a.help_text: Enables view A. Left unset, the pipeline analyses view X only - hicpup skips a view whose fountain BED is absent.

resolution.description: Bin size in bp. Validated against the cooler's binsize.

flank.description: Pileup flank in bp; yields a (2*flank/resolution + 1) square matrix.
flank.help_text: Must fit the chromosome. If the window runs off the end, coolpuppy piles up zero windows and returns an all-NaN matrix WITHOUT failing - the run goes green and the figure is empty.

ndiags.description: Antidiagonals stacked per side of the cone.
ndiags.help_text: Bounded by the pileup matrix size; too large raises an IndexError from cone.cone_diagonals. For a 41x41 matrix the limit is 17.

min_diag.description: Diagonals nearest the anchor to mask.

hic2cool_container.description: Image carrying hic2cool. Used only when an input is .hic.
